mother-in-law noun

classical

Traupman 24
Ter. Hec.

socrus, socrūs f.

noun, fourth declension

Examples

  • Deinde māter socrum quoque, quae prope stābat, salūtāvit.

    Then Mum said hello to her mother-in-law too, who was standing nearby.Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

See also mother.
